measurements.evidence_quote: CS-NPs exhibited a strong positive charge (+ 40.1 ± 2.20 mV), while both I. sakaiensis (-10.1 ± 1.19 mV) and PET microspheres (-0.645 ± 0.01 mV) were negatively charged, providing a driving force for the electrostatic attraction (Zeng et al. 2026).
